plugin.editor.open.description: The editor opened its file: the first read, its load into the document and the start of the watch. bytes and lines are those of the document; error names a failed open.

plugin.editor.read.description: A later read of the file: reason is reload (the command) or watch (a change on disk).

plugin.editor.save.description: A write of the document in place; overwrite is true when the person chose to overwrite a file that changed on disk.

plugin.editor.watch.start.description: The request to the files sidecar to watch the file.

plugin.editor.watch.change.description: The files sidecar reported a change of a watched file.

plugin.editor.watch.error.description: The files sidecar stopped the watch and reported why.

plugin.editor.disk.decision.description: What the editor decided after a read that followed a change on disk: same (the version did not change), loaded (the document had no changes and took the file) or conflict (the document has changes, so the banner asks the person).

plugin.editor.format.description: One run of the formatter of editor.formatter for the file; formatter is the plugin that contributed it.

plugin.editor.contribution.failed.description: A contribution to editor.extension or editor.formatter failed to load or build and was left out.

plugin.editor.command.description: The result of a declared command of the editor.

plugin.editor.request.description: A request to the files sidecar and its reply; error is the failure of the send or the error of the reply.

plugin.editor.close.description: The editor surface ended; pending is the number of requests to the files sidecar that had no reply.
